scope: Official-source basis and prospective repair-experiment design; no target statistics, new cohort, clinical threshold, or source-body redistribution.
source_qualifications: Component identity applies to underlying paired concentrations, not automatically to error-contaminated independently reported measurements.
Distinct analytical reactions do not establish independent errors or a joint error distribution.
The PTS insert does not identify the historical assay or supply cohort-specific assay-error parameters.
Analytical measuring ranges are not biological validity limits.

rule.basis: Inferred component constraint from total-cholesterol composition and non-HDL = total minus HDL definitions.
required_scope: Declared common units or explicit conversion
Declared latent/coherent or observed measurement interpretation
rule.observed_application: Observed violation diagnostic; explicitly supported observation model required for an assay-error explanation. Check latent consistency separately when latent quantities exist.
rule.unknown_interpretation_application: Diagnostic requiring interpretation; no automatic rejection or exemption.
rule.measurement_inference_limit: Distinct analytical reactions and documented imprecision support possible measurement discrepancies, not independent errors, a joint error distribution, or proof that generated violations are assay noise.
report: Positive HDL-minus-TC excess magnitude in declared units
Numerical or rounding tolerance and justification
not_implied: Manufacturer analytical range as biological bound
Marginal source SD as validated joint assay-error model

sources.locator: Pages 1–2: intended use, principles of the test, limitations, performance characteristics

baseline.handling: Copy unchanged into new experimental unit; do not edit closed bundle.

experiment_assessment.suitable_for: Bounded development test of source-grounded rule use and transparent revision tradeoffs.
experiment_assessment.declared_new_unit_interpretation: Underlying same-specimen lipid concentration scenarios; no explicit assay-error model. Raw component counts remain reported even if the author disputes applicability.
experiment_assessment.planned_reference_access: No real-target comparison in this unit.
freeze_before_evaluation: Preset seed set and cohort size
experiment_assessment.revision_budget_recommendation: One bounded revision opportunity; retain or abstain is valid.
experiment_assessment.evaluation: Compare unchanged baseline and revision on all prescribed analyses and coherence diagnostics; retain outputs and expose distributional tradeoffs.
experiment_assessment.seed_limit: Common seeds do not imply matched people or latent draws if random-number consumption changes, nor clinical uncertainty or general efficacy.
experiment_assessment.interpretation_change: An explicit use-claim change is required; silent observed-to-latent relabelling cannot count as repair under the original claim.
experiment_assessment.prior_reference_limit: No target comparison is planned. In general, a post-closure comparison against previously exposed aggregate references would remain a development comparison, not new independent validation.
experiment_assessment.permitted_claim: A source-grounded rule informed a bounded revision; report its measured component-coherence and analysis tradeoffs under the declared interpretation.
excluded_claims: Overall gain from coherence counts alone
General or causal effectiveness of agent feedback
